content:
root = Stack([title, summary, cascade, note])
title = TextContent("Auth DB Failure Cascade", "large-heavy")
summary = Callout("error", "Primary impact", "auth-db failure immediately takes down auth-service and then propagates through dependent services.")
cascade = Steps([step1, step2, step3, step4, step5, step6])
step1 = StepsItem("1. auth-db fails", "The originating failure. No other listed service depends directly on auth-db.")
step2 = StepsItem("2. auth-service fails", "auth-service depends on auth-db, so authentication-related requests fail.")
step3 = StepsItem("3. session-cache and admin-console fail", "session-cache and admin-console both depend directly on auth-service.")
step4 = StepsItem("4. api-gateway fails", "api-gateway depends on auth-service and session-cache. Both dependencies are unavailable.")
step5 = StepsItem("5. checkout and search fail", "checkout depends on api-gateway, and search depends on api-gateway as well as search-index. The gateway failure is sufficient to break both.")
step6 = StepsItem("6. notifications and reporting fail", "notifications depends on checkout, while reporting depends on admin-console. Both fail after their upstream dependencies fail.")
note = TextCallout("info", "Unaffected direct dependency", "payments and fraud-check are not in the auth-db dependency chain. Payments may remain available independently, but checkout still fails because it also requires the unavailable api-gateway.")
